title: FL-4131 recorder extended-glyph diagnostic schema (W7 draft)
description: Versioned schema for two recorder event families that carry the extended-glyph identity diagnostic: per-frame samples and missing-glyph events. Does NOT replace existing recorder fields; this is an additive contract for Phase 2+ runtime to populate. Phase 0/1 runtime MUST NOT emit these fields. The cell.gl byte is NEVER proof of extended identity — full GlyphId identity is always uint32 and lives in the recorder field below.

row_version.description: Recorder row schema version for the extended-glyph diagnostic. Phase 0/1 = 1.

glyph_id.description: Full 32-bit GlyphId identity. CP437 values live in 0..255; extended values live in 256.. . MUST NOT be derived from the 8-bit cell.gl byte at the renderer layer; the source is the bundle-side resolved glyph id.

anyOf.description: 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bound glyph manifest.

sample.description: Per-frame sample carrying the bound manifest identity and the dominant glyph id seen during the frame.

extended_cell_count.description: Count of cells in this frame whose GlyphId > 255. MUST be 0 in Phase 0/1; Phase 2+ may emit positive counts.

fallback_used_cell_count.description: Count of cells in this frame that resolved through the fallback path.

event.description: Discrete event emitted when an unknown / missing glyph fallback is taken at a specific render surface.

source_path.description: Optional XP / asset path that triggered this event.
